title: Native deterministic config composition

Work is organized into gated waves with parallel tracks where independent. Every implementation wave is followed by an independent subagent audit. If an audit finds defects, create remediation child tasks, keep the audit open, and require the same independent auditor or a fresh auditor to re-audit the remediated snapshot before the next wave becomes ready.
acceptance_criteria: All wave, parallel-track, remediation, and audit tasks are closed; semantic differential, fail-closed version skew, large-JSON transport, worktree isolation, adversarial, mutation, documentation, performance, clean-package, and final release-readiness gates pass. Live external worktrees are never mutated without explicit authorization. No publish, push, PR, global install/link, or public action occurs without explicit authorization.

Current line/default-quoted parsing drops tracked filenames containing LF and corrupts ordinary UTF-8 such as café.md, so graph/externalities can falsely pass. Preserve staged-deletion index-only semantics, distinguish missing objects from operational failures, retain bounded capture, and cover non-colocated jj.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic source and packed regressions prove exact LF, tab, and valid UTF-8 tracked paths survive graph/list/changed/impact/anchor inventories; a leak in such a path makes externalities fail with the exact path; explicit seed endpoints resolve. Git path streams are captured as bytes, split on terminal NUL, and decoded with fatal UTF-8; malformed/truncated NUL streams and invalid UTF-8 filenames exit 2 as vcs-read-failed rather than false-clean. Old newline/default-quoted and replacement-decoding mutants are killed. Existing >1 MiB, >64 MiB, staged deletion, unborn Git, legacy Git, and jj cases remain green.

Coverage: >1MiB and >64MiB, NUL/JSONL paths, LF/tab/Unicode/BOM, invalid UTF8/malformed fail-loud, staged rename/deletion, unborn Git, jj failures, symlink link-text policy/leak scans, direct and symlinked --repo root-probe failures. title: Wave 1: TDD pure deterministic composed-config loader
description: Add failing pure-loader T80 tests first, then implement one side-effect-free deterministic composed-config loader that parses, duplicate-checks, validates, normalizes, merges, bounds, and records repo-relative declaration provenance before CONFIG/OUT/FACTS/SYMBOLS are exposed. Core safety belongs here: missing/malformed/non-regular fragments, path/symlink containment, traversal/cycle/diamond behavior, collisions, duplicate JSON keys per contract, resource ceilings, and validation-before-write-path. Preserve legacy no-include behavior. Do not claim CLI/graph parity until Wave 2 wiring.
acceptance_criteria: Direct production-loader tests cover the complete schema and frozen merge algebra. Deterministic generated configs are randomly partitioned with persisted seeds, replay corpus, and minimized counterexamples; valid partitions keep each logical-owner group intact and preserve normalized semantic bytes/algebra, while invalid cross-source collisions fail order-independently with all origins. Manifest grouping/order permutations are invariant. Because v1 forbids recursion, self/root/sibling/cycle/diamond nested-include attempts fail before any grandchild read; maximum composition depth is exactly root to fragment. Omitted versus explicit defaults follow the contract. Tests call production code, not a test-only merger. Path, any-component symlink, root symlink, missing/malformed/non-regular, collision, bounds, duplicate-key, invalid UTF-8, and partial-activation regressions fail before output computation or writes. Legacy no-include fixtures remain unchanged. Focused T80 loader and existing T46/T47/T48-style tests pass.

acceptance_criteria: A command-to-child-only-sentinel table proves graph/build/status/check/check-committed/impact+proof/policy/externalities/verify-scope/run+strict+no-write/gate+committed/export/symbols/strictSpans and target-root selection consume the same composition. Flat/composed exit code, JSON envelope, stderr class, semanticProjection, and write-set match exactly. Version/help/capabilities/robot-docs/hooks/unknown command or flag retain precedence and do not traverse malformed includes or write. An older supported/released binary invoked on the composed-root format fails closed rather than returning an inert green result; a minVersion key ignored by old code is not accepted as the sole guard. Staging matrix covers staged fragment+graph pass, staged fragment without graph fail, staged graph plus unstaged fragment drift fail, delete/rename fail, and untracked child behavior. Two disposable linked worktrees begin with distinct sentinel caches and identical config hashes but different content, build concurrently, and cannot alter each other's bytes/inode/mtime/hash.
